title: Linear public-coin lower bound for Index
statement: For every positive integer $n \ge 300$, the one-way public-coin communication complexity of the Index function on $n$-bit strings and indices in $[n]$, at error $1/9$, is strictly greater than $\lfloor n/10\rfloor$.
replaced:
For $n \ge 300$, the public-coin one-way communication complexity of $\mathrm{IND}_n$ at error
$1/9$ is strictly greater than $\lfloor n/10 \rfloor$:
\[
  R^{\to,\mathrm{pub}}_{1/9}(\mathrm{IND}_n) > \lfloor n/10 \rfloor .
\]
This is the Kremer--Nisan--Ron linear lower bound with explicit constants.
